# BossBoard

BossBoard is invoicing, quotes and job records for New Zealand tradespeople (electricians, plumbers, builders and other trades), with 15% GST built in.

## About
BossBoard is a mobile and web app from Instilligent Limited. Tradies use it to quote, invoice, log jobs and hours, track expenses and certifications, and run a small team. It also drafts Safe Work Method Statements: SWMS templates aligned to the Health and Safety at Work Act 2015 — you stay the PCBU and sign off.

## Key Features
- **Invoicing**: Professional invoices with 15% GST built in, PDF export and email.
- **Quotes**: Quotes and estimates with one-tap conversion to invoices.
- **Jobs**: Job logging with clock in/out and hours per site and per worker.
- **Expenses and photos**: Expense tracking (7 categories) and GPS-tagged photos attached to jobs, invoices and SWMS.
- **Certifications**: Licence and certification tracking with expiry reminders at 30, 14, 7 and 1 days.
- **Teams**: Invite team members and assign roles (Team plan, up to 5 members).
- **SWMS**: AI-assisted SWMS drafts. SWMS templates aligned to the Health and Safety at Work Act 2015 — you stay the PCBU and sign off. Templates and starting material, not legal advice.
- **Offline**: The mobile app works offline and syncs when back online.

## Pricing (NZD)
- Free: $0 (3 invoices and 2 SWMS per month, single user).
- Tradie: $4.99/week.
- Team: $9.99/week (up to 5 team members).
- Free during beta. Paid tiers from $4.99/week when we launch billing.
